scripts.build: echo 'nothing to do, please use make for available commands'
scripts.heroku-postbuild: make pkgs-build && cd api && pnpm build
scripts.codesandbox:init: pnpm install && pnpm run pkgs:types:check && pnpm run pkgs:build
scripts.pkgs:build: pnpm ls --filter "./packages/*" --depth -1 --no-color | sed -E 's|.*/([^/]+)$|\1|' | xargs -P 8 -I '{}' sh -c 'PACKAGE={} pnpm run pkg:build || 255'
